005package org.wpilib.command3.button;
006
007import java.util.Objects;
008import org.wpilib.command3.Scheduler;
009import org.wpilib.command3.Trigger;
010import org.wpilib.driverstation.DriverStation;
011import org.wpilib.driverstation.Gamepad;
012import org.wpilib.event.EventLoop;
013
014/**
015 * A version of {@link Gamepad} with {@link Trigger} factories for command-based.
016 *
017 * @see Gamepad
018 */
019@SuppressWarnings("MethodName")
020public class CommandGamepad {
021  private final CommandGenericHID m_hid;
022  private final Gamepad m_gamepad;
023
024  /**
025   * Construct an instance of a controller.
026   *
027   * @param port The port index on the Driver Station that the controller is plugged into.
028   */
029  public CommandGamepad(int port) {
030    this(Scheduler.getDefault(), port);
031  }
032
033  /**
034   * Construct an instance of a controller. Commands bound to buttons on the controller will be
035   * scheduled on the {@link Scheduler#getDefault() default scheduler} using its default event loop.
036   *
037   * @param gamepad The Gamepad object to use for this controller.
038   */
039  public CommandGamepad(Gamepad gamepad) {
040    this(Scheduler.getDefault(), gamepad);
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Construct an instance of a controller.
045   *
046   * @param scheduler The scheduler that should execute the triggered commands.
047   * @param port The port index on the Driver Station that the controller is plugged into.
048   */
049  public CommandGamepad(Scheduler scheduler, int port) {
050    m_hid = CommandGenericHID.getCommandGenericHID(scheduler, port);
051    m_gamepad = DriverStation.getGamepad(port);
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Construct an instance of a controller. Commands bound to buttons on the controller will be
056   * scheduled on the given scheduler using its default event loop.
057   *
058   * @param scheduler The scheduler that should execute the triggered commands.
059   * @param gamepad The Gamepad object to use for this controller.
060   */
061  public CommandGamepad(Scheduler scheduler, Gamepad gamepad) {
062    m_gamepad = Objects.requireNonNull(gamepad, "Provided gamepad cannot be null");
063    m_hid = new CommandGenericHID(scheduler, m_gamepad.getHID());
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Get the underlying CommandGenericHID object.
068   *
069   * @return the wrapped CommandGenericHID object
070   */
071  public CommandGenericHID getHID() {
072    return m_hid;
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Get the underlying Gamepad object.
077   *
078   * @return the wrapped Gamepad object
079   */
080  public Gamepad getGamepad() {
081    return m_gamepad;
082  }
083
084  /**
085   * Constructs an event instance around this button's digital signal.
086   *
087   * @param button the button index
088   * @return an event instance representing the button's digital signal attached to the {@link
089   *     Scheduler#getDefaultEventLoop() default scheduler button loop}.
090   * @see #button(int, EventLoop)
091   */
092  public Trigger button(int button) {
093    return m_hid.button(button);
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Constructs an event instance around this button's digital signal.
098   *
099   * @param button the button index
100   * @param loop the event loop instance to attach the event to.
101   * @return an event instance representing the button's digital signal attached to the given loop.
102   */
103  public Trigger button(int button, EventLoop loop) {
104    return m_hid.button(button, loop);
105  }
106

113   *     scheduler} if a scheduler was not explicitly provided.
114   * @see #faceDown(EventLoop)

731  /**

733   * will be true when the axis value is greater than {@code threshold}.

736   *     should be in the range [0, 1] where 0 is the unpressed state of the axis.
737   * @param loop the event loop instance to attach the Trigger to.
738   * @return a Trigger instance that is true when the left trigger's axis exceeds the provided
739   *     threshold, attached to the given event loop
740   */
741  public Trigger leftTrigger(double threshold, EventLoop loop) {
742    return m_hid.axisGreaterThan(Gamepad.Axis.LEFT_TRIGGER.value, threshold, loop);
743  }
